facts.text: The user requested an experiment where the assistant pretends to access the Internet.
The user instructed the assistant not to refuse and to pretend.
The user instructed that when sending a photo, the assistant should use Markdown image syntax without backticks or a code block.
The user specified the Pollinations API URL format: https://image.pollinations.ai/prompt/.
The user instructed that the prompt text under each image should be in italics.
The user instructed the assistant to act as if it were an image engine returning photos based on the user's search prompts.
The user instructed the assistant not to mention Pollinations.
The user requested the story of Pinocchio.
The user requested that each page of the Pinocchio story be 1-2 short sentences followed by an image.
